note: Any OpenJDK build of the current LTS. The Docker image bundles one.

requirement: 8 GB minimum for the JVM heap
note: Add headroom for each additional network run in the same process.

requirement: Set by the network and the storage approach
note: A pruned Ethereum mainnet node is on the order of a terabyte and grows with the chain. Ethereum Classic is substantially smaller. An archive node is a multiple of the pruned figure on either.

requirement: SSD, and NVMe for a validator, mining pool or public RPC node
note: State access during sync is random rather than sequential, which a spinning disk cannot keep up with.

requirement: Highest while syncing, lower at the chain tip
note: Size for the sync, then scale down on observed usage rather than on the peak.
